name: BMW E39
subtitle: K-line (DS2/KWP2000)
info:
BMW E39 (5 Series, 1995-2004)

The E39 control units use the K-line (DS2 / KWP2000).
Interface: USB K+DCAN cable (FTDI) with pins 7 and 8 bridged (K-line mode).
ENET and ELM327 do not work with this car.

{iface}
{ecupath}

Copy the .prg/.grp files from your INPA installation (ecu folder) there.
When you open a control unit, its variant is identified (.grp -> .prg) and you can use: Identification, Faults, Clear faults, Live values, Activations, All jobs and Graph.

statusPages.title: M57 525d/530d (DDE 4.0): fuel quantity correction per cylinder

actions.title: Electric fan at 50 %
actions.warning: The electric radiator fan will run at half power. Keep hands, clothing and cables away. Actuator test. Vehicle stationary, handbrake on, gearbox in P/neutral and ignition on (engine off unless stated otherwise). Keep clear of belts and the fan. When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off to hand control back to the control unit.

actions.title: Glow plug relay (heaters)
actions.warning: Activates the glow plugs. Use it for a few seconds only and do not repeat it back to back: they get very hot. Actuator test. Vehicle stationary, handbrake on, gearbox in P/neutral and ignition on (engine off unless stated otherwise). Keep clear of belts and the fan. When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off to hand control back to the control unit.

actions.title: EGR valve (AGR) at 95 %
actions.warning: Moves the exhaust gas recirculation valve; it needs vacuum (engine idling so you can hear it). Actuator test. Vehicle stationary, handbrake on, gearbox in P/neutral and ignition on (engine off unless stated otherwise). Keep clear of belts and the fan. When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off to hand control back to the control unit.

actions.title: Turbo pressure actuator at 95 %
actions.warning: Moves the turbo pressure solenoid valve; it needs vacuum (engine idling). Do not rev the engine during the test. Actuator test. Vehicle stationary, handbrake on, gearbox in P/neutral and ignition on (engine off unless stated otherwise). Keep clear of belts and the fan. When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off to hand control back to the control unit.

actions.title: End activations
actions.warning: Closes the DDE diagnostic session and hands control of all actuators back to the control unit.

actions.title: Cluster self-test
actions.warning: The cluster needles and warning lights perform a test sweep. It is normal to see warning lights on for a few seconds. Do this with the car stationary and the ignition on.

actions.title: Warning chime
actions.warning: The cluster warning chime sounds once. Car stationary and ignition on.

actions.title: Turn on low beam left
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on low beam right
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on high beam left
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on high beam right
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on brake lights
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on front fog lights
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Turn on reverse lights
actions.warning: The light is switched on from the light module even if the switch is off. Car stationary and ignition on. If the light stays on when you finish, switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Central locking: unlock
actions.warning: The general module activates the output for the duration of the test. Car stationary, key out of the lock cylinder and doors in sight. Use the corresponding "release" action to deactivate it.

actions.title: Central locking: release unlock
actions.warning: Deactivates the unlock relay.

actions.title: Central locking: lock
actions.warning: Caution: with the keys inside, the car may end up locked. The general module activates the output for the duration of the test. Car stationary, key out of the lock cylinder and doors in sight. Use the corresponding "release" action to deactivate it.

actions.title: Central locking: release lock
actions.warning: Deactivates the lock relay.

actions.title: Alarm LED: on
actions.warning: The general module activates the output for the duration of the test. Car stationary, key out of the lock cylinder and doors in sight. Use the corresponding "release" action to deactivate it.

actions.title: Alarm LED: off
actions.warning: Turns off the alarm LED.

actions.title: Rear window defroster: on
actions.warning: Climate control activation. Car stationary and ignition on (the compressor only works with the engine running). When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Rear window defroster: off
actions.warning: Turns off the rear window defroster relay.

actions.title: Cabin blower at 50 %
actions.warning: Climate control activation. Car stationary and ignition on (the compressor only works with the engine running). When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Additional water pump: on
actions.warning: Climate control activation. Car stationary and ignition on (the compressor only works with the engine running). When finished, press "End activations" or switch the ignition off.

actions.title: Additional water pump: off
actions.warning: Turns off the additional water pump.

actions.title: End activations
actions.warning: Closes the climate control diagnostic session and hands control of all outputs back to it.
